description: swmm_clogging_audit: Reproducible harness for an engine-level audit of SWMM's permeable pavement clogging factor is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chuyang Hu (Department of Computer Science and Engineering, University of California, Santa Cruz). This archive contains the reproducible Python harness and data supporting the manuscript "A double-counted paver fraction in EPA SWMM's clogging conversion, and when permeable-pavement conductivity loss is hydraulically active: an engine audit" (Chuyang Hu). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
